Product analytics: saved reports, profiles, raw event export and event import.

## API key

1. Open [mixpanel.com](https://mixpanel.com/settings/org#serviceaccounts) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** A service account from Organization Settings > Service Accounts.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add mixpanel
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  mixpanel: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Mixpanel's [API](https://docs.mixpanel.com/reference/overview) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show mixpanel` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** Per project: Query API 60 queries an hour, 5 at once; Raw Data Export 60 an hour, 3 a second, 100 at once; ingestion about 2 GB a minute.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Mixpanel).
